dense_softmax: A common shift of every gate row leaves all softmax probabilities unchanged.
sparse_top_k: For k>1, a common shift preserves ordering, the Top-k set, and the renormalized softmax probabilities within it.
expert_invariants: Each SwiGLU expert retains its independent A-column/C-row inverse-scaling symmetry.
scope: Displayed dense and sparse laws; no independent no-additional-laws proof.
